facts.fact: At the 22 June 2021 inauguration of the Diamniadio national datacenter, the president instructed all state structures to host their data and platforms there; the state agency ADIE (now Sénégal Numérique SA) was entrusted with the Smart Sénégal programme that built it.

The president said Senegalese young engineers will continue to manage the national datacenter, and ADIE's director general said 720 direct jobs were being recruited for the Sénégal Services spaces and datacenter management.
